PM Modi references Bageshwar Baba at IIT Delhi convocation, students laugh

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the convocation ceremony at IIT Delhi, offering students advice on life experiences and skills. During his speech, he referenced 'Baba Bageshwar', which elicited laughter from the Gen-Z students present. The students also applauded his remarks.
